# Generated by RAD C++ from rv32emu-qt.radcpp - do not edit. Manual additions go to project.cmake.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28)
project(rv32emu-qt LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)

file(GLOB_RECURSE RADCPP_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS src/*.cpp src/*.c)
file(GLOB_RECURSE RADCPP_HEADERS CONFIGURE_DEPENDS include/*.hpp include/*.h)
file(GLOB_RECURSE RADCPP_FORMS CONFIGURE_DEPENDS forms/*.ui)
add_executable(rv32emu-qt ${RADCPP_SOURCES} ${RADCPP_HEADERS} ${RADCPP_FORMS})
target_include_directories(rv32emu-qt PRIVATE include)

# --- libraries
find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Widgets)
target_link_libraries(rv32emu-qt PRIVATE Qt6::Widgets)
# RAD C++ components are built by the IDE into <RAD_CPP>/build/sdk; terminal builds pass -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH="/opt/homebrew;<RAD_CPP>/build/sdk"
find_package(RadCpp REQUIRED CONFIG COMPONENTS Components)
target_link_libraries(rv32emu-qt PRIVATE RadCpp::Components)

# --- qt: moc, uic and rcc run automatically. Ninja re-runs them only for files in its depfile, and a
# header found by the glob is not in there, so the source list is kept as its own listfile.
set_target_properties(rv32emu-qt PROPERTIES AUTOMOC ON AUTOUIC ON AUTORCC ON)
function(radcpp_track_sources_for_autogen name)
    list(JOIN ARGN "\n# " text)
    set(file "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${name}_sources.cmake")
    file(CONFIGURE OUTPUT "${file}" CONTENT "# ${text}\n" @ONLY)
    include("${file}")
endfunction()
radcpp_track_sources_for_autogen(rv32emu-qt ${RADCPP_SOURCES} ${RADCPP_HEADERS} ${RADCPP_FORMS})

# --- forms: ui_<Form>.h comes from forms/<dir>/<Form>.ui, generated into rv32emu-qt_autogen/include
set(RADCPP_FORM_DIRS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/forms)
foreach(form ${RADCPP_FORMS})
    get_filename_component(dir "${form}" DIRECTORY)
    list(APPEND RADCPP_FORM_DIRS "${dir}")
endforeach()
list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES RADCPP_FORM_DIRS)
set_target_properties(rv32emu-qt PROPERTIES AUTOUIC_SEARCH_PATHS "${RADCPP_FORM_DIRS}")

# --- skin: res/skin and include/radcpp_skin.hpp are generated from rv32emu-qt.radcpp [skin]
qt_add_resources(rv32emu-qt "radcpp_skin" PREFIX "/radcpp/skin" BASE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/res/skin"
    FILES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/res/skin/skin.qss ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/res/skin/check.svg ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/res/skin/radio.svg ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/res/skin/arrow-down.svg ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/res/skin/arrow-up.svg)

# --- resources: every file under res/ is available as :/res/<path>
file(GLOB_RECURSE RADCPP_RES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS res/*)
list(FILTER RADCPP_RES EXCLUDE REGEX "/res/skin/")
if(RADCPP_RES)
    qt_add_resources(rv32emu-qt "radcpp_res" PREFIX "/res" BASE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/res" FILES ${RADCPP_RES})
endif()

# --- manual additions
include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/project.cmake OPTIONAL)
